integrity: The proof combines characteristic-subgroup arguments with a complete exact enumeration of GL_4(2) and the affine normalizer; no numerical approximation or sampling is used.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns one explicit order-160 semidirect product and does not determine the full abstract automorphism group or orbit profiles for all five-orbit groups.
title: Automorphism-orbit size profile of the exceptional five-orbit semidirect product
